releasefoundry_public_merge_gate.blocking_reason: Reviewed ReleaseFoundry grading observations with review_status=reviewed, a canonical reviewer_receipt, a positive reviewed_at_unix_ms, and canonical private evidence_ref must be imported from one acceptance run bound to the fixed dataset identity, complete run lifecycle, exact test set, server-observed grader version, and independently verified per-test terminal scoring. The retained public run receipt must hash-bind every observation and match every run-level and per-test scoring field. Aggregate markers are not acceptance authority; merge and regenerate before C3 is met.

semantic_live_merge_gate.blocking_reason: Audited semantic judge observations with canonical private evidence refs must replace offline references before C4 is met. Per-case evidence is acceptance authority; aggregate availability and reviewed-count markers must match it.
